d.ko: 디지털 디럭스 콘텐츠 및 점프 스타트 팩, 언더그라운드 R-201 Carbine 커스텀 무기 스킨이 포함되어 있습니다.
d.en: Respawn Entertainment gives you the most advanced titan technology in its new, single player campaign & multiplayer experience. Combine & conquer with new titans & pilots, deadlier weapons, & customization and progression systems that help you and your titan flow as one unstoppable killing force.
d.zh: 跃升起始包内含所有数字豪华版内容，让您快速升级和解锁物品，还有 R-201 卡宾枪的地下定制武器皮肤。
